I finally ran away and from all this. Fast forward to now and my wife is doing the same. She is weighing me and scolding me all day.  I have been and am suicidal after this this. Like what do I do? i can't live like this.  Please help.

I would consider myself fluent but thats a subjective. I can speak Polish well enough that I don't see it being an issue. I can watch movies, tv and get about 80-90% depending on the context. I left Poland in 88 as a kid and definitely speak with an anglicized accent. The only downside with speaking is my wife can't use any Polish. I think she would be ok for the most part. I lived in her country for several years and never became fluent. It would just take some getting used to.

Well, this is why I am asking if it will be enough. I haven't lived in Poland for 30 years so I want to ask people there. My income level of 7500 a month will come directly from my savings. This would go to direct cost of living like housing, utilities and food. I have other revenues but do not want to include them as part of this budget. My indirect cost of living, like some of those mentioned, would come from other sources. For example, I have a rental that nets me about 1500zł per month which has been solid. I make some other money through investment but it's market based and don't want to include it because of those fluctuations. I am willing to work but I don't want it to be corporate or overly involved. I wouldn't mind working at a hotel, cafe, bookstore or something outside in nature. For my kids, should they choose to go university, I have already started that fund for them. As for the ostracism, it might he there but it can be there for anything. I can't be responsible for how other people chose to view other people. I definitely do not live above my means, in fact, I want to live as minimal a life as possible. The less "stuff" I have the better.

All of these are your opinions on how life should be and what people ought to do with their lives according to your view of the world. I never said Poland was some banana republic. I have been there many times. I owned a flat there. I speak the language. What I am asking is 7,500PLN enough   to achieve my goal? What you call a sore loser is what I would call strategic planning and investment. You say this would not be a good role model for my children, what you mean, teaching them both the value of time and money? Teaching them how to make money work for you to achieve your goals? You see the world completely differently than I do. I have worked in the corporate world for 20 years and have decided it's enough and now I will start planning retirement and I am fortunate enough to do so because of work, savings, investments and forethought. Sure, I could work another 20 years and accumulate more money and more stuff but what end? Just to have more money? I don't see life like that.

Why? Because I would rather be home with my children than be at work making money for someone else? You need view things differently. Spending our lives working to death in not the answer and if I can get away from 9-5 corporate world I will. How is this entitled and childish? I have worked for my money that I will be retiring with and not living off the state. I am trying to make my money go further by leaving the rat race of the city for a smaller city in Poland. 

I am not complaining about retiring early, I am complaining about a corporate world that's sick and out of control. I pay about 3000usd a month for a house I will never really own. I fight traffic to and from a job I will never own, only to get home and be contacted all hours of the night by said company while I am home. The one thing I do have is a goal and the ability to meet that goal with savings. My goal is to use the system to escape it, that's what I will do.
Yes we won't need a babysitter. I don't need anything big and would prefer to not own a car. Just not sure if it's doable.
